title: Add a release
description: Creates one file for a release under project-docs/releases/, with a release-name identity field, project-docs-ancestors pointing at the features in scope, and a goal-statement placeholder body. This is how a delivery boundary enters the artifact graph — the CI harness reads active release artifacts to derive artifact_scope automatically.

releaseName.description: The release name (e.g. "v1.0", "2025-Q4"). Used as the release-name frontmatter field and to derive the file slug.
releaseName.x-prompt: What is the release name (e.g. v1.0, 2025-Q4)?

project.description: Scope this release to a specific project's project-docs/releases/ instead of the workspace root.

projectDocsAncestors.description: Paths to existing project-docs/features/*.md files that are in scope for this release.
